title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and optimize cache parallelism
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows to reduce duplication, improved cache keys and parallelism for faster lint/test runs, and bumped GH Actions used. No functional changes to runtime code.
description: Motivation: our GitHub Actions setup has grown organically and duplicated lint/test/release logic across multiple workflows which increases maintenance burden and CI runtime. This PR consolidates the workflows into a smaller set of coordinated jobs, standardizes cache key strategy, and tweaks parallelism for faster pipelines without increasing flakiness. Changes include: - Consolidate five workflows into two: .github/workflows/ci.yml (lint + test matrix) and .github/workflows/release.yml (release automation + changelog). - Standardize cache keys to include OS, node-version, and package-lock-hash to reduce cache misses. - Introduce controlled parallelism for test matrices (max-parallel per-matrix via strategy.max-parallel) to balance runner utilization and cache effectiveness. - Update several actions to latest patch versions and fix breaking inputs where necessary. - Add a small helper script tools/ci/cache-inspector.sh to aid debugging cache misses during PR validation. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows and validate matrix logic - [x] Verify caches hit across representative repos - [x] Run full e2e on redwood and redwood-sdk-python - [x] Smoke test release workflow in staging - [x] Add documentation note in docs/dev/ci.md for maintainers Notes on risk: no production code touched; primary risk is CI flakiness/regression which we mitigated by running the full suite and adding a canary run on a separate branch. See CI run history for reruns of a flaky matrix job (restarted once) and final green status. Related: ENG-2345 (CI consolidation epic), SUP-987 (support ticket referencing flakey release job).

Observed ~20% reduction in median CI runtime for lint+test compared to previous baseline after controlled parallelism and better cache hits. Recommend follow-up to add a lightweight presubmit that verifies cache key correctness for new workflows.
changelog_entry: ci: consolidate workflows and optimize cache parallelism (reduces CI runtime, improves cache hit rate)
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: transient CI flakiness introduced by workflow changes. Mitigation: ran full test suites, staged release canary, added cache-inspector and docs for maintainers. Rollback plan: revert workflow files and re-enable previous file-level workflows while investigating any persistent failures.
